Hey, I'm Kairi!

I'm a Communication student at the University of California-San Diego who loves the intersection of beauty and fashion marketing. I specialize in event planning and media strategy, creating digital and in-person experiences that capture attention, spark engagement, and grow brand reach. My early love of creating visuals and editing grew into a passion for advertising, and it's what has led me to pursue marketing today.

Conceptual Projects

KimChi Blush Launch

I designed this to capture the attention of a Gen-Z audience by blending high-energy aesthetics cohesively. I moved away from polished corporate advertising and chose a lo-fi look that mimics organic digital art, like the style found on TikTok and Pinterest, where aesthetic resonance is key to engagement.

Tower 28 x Heytea

This partnership celebrates Asian-founded businesses that have successfully scaled globally. By blending Tower 28’s face care approach with Heytea’s trending beverage culture, the project shows how both brands have modernized traditional values into a cohesive, culturally resonant aesthetic.
